skills.name: Crab Claw Cannon
skills.description:
Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150<font color='#D58E1F'>( +160% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the first enemy hit and then 150% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10<font color='#27C0C7'>( +10% Total Magic Power)</font>% for 1s.
Every 100 <font color='#D58E1F'>(Physical Attack)</font> Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.
skills.tips: Menghasilkan Physical Damage serta efek Slow kepada target. Tidak hanya itu, Armor musuh yang terkena skill 1 Bane juga akan terkurang selama 2 detik.

skills.name: Ale
skills.description:
Bane chugs his ale, recovering 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +150% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 5<font color='#27C0C7'>( +1% Total Magic Power)</font>% of his lost HP and gaining 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Bane spits venom in the target direction, dealing 250<font color='#27C0C7'>( +180% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> (scales up to 150% with charging time) to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Every 100 <font color='#27C0C7'>(Magic Power)</font> Bane possesses additionally reduces this skill's cooldown by 7%.
skills.tips: Bane akan mengeluarkan gentong yang dapat memulihkan HP yang ada di dekat gentong tersebut. (HP teman satu tim juga akan bertambah)

skills.name: Deadly Catch
skills.description:
Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in the target direction, dealing 600<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+170% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies hit, knocking them airborne for 0.8s, and slowing them by 65% (decays over 3s).
This skill deals 40% damage to turrets.
skills.tips: Bane akan mengeluarkan kapal yang terbang dan menjatuhkan meriam kepada siapa saja yang berada di bawahnya, termasuk Turret.

skills.name: Shark Bite
skills.description: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of <font color='#404495'>(Tidal Energy)</font> each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> equal to <font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> plus 3.5(+0.3*Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies.
skills.tips: Setiap 6 detik sekali Basic Attack Bane akan meningkat dan menimbulkan Splash, musuh yang berada di belakang target yang dipukul akan terkena Damage yang sangat besar dan mendapatkan efek Slow. (termasuk Turret).

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: War Axe
items.des: Unique Passive - Fighting Spirit: Dealing damage grants 12 extra Physical Attack and 2% extra Spell Vamp per second for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Deal 10% extra True Damage according to Base Damage at full stacks.####[C8This effect is reduced to 50% for Marksmen, Mages, and Supports.]

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.des: Unique Passive - Retribution: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3s (8s cooldown).

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: Rapis Boots - Bloodlust Axe - Hunter Strike - Malefic Roar - Berserker's Fury - Blade of Despair
